defect.proposed_fix: Keep field_i_validity: good_law as of 2026-06-30, but phrase the prose as 'No confirmed negative treatment in the lake judgment fields; proposed/audit-needed progeny signals are classified as mentioned and no point overrides are recorded.'

reasons: Lake treatment.field_i_validity is good_law as of 2026-06-30, varies_by_point is false, and point_overrides is empty.

residual_risks: A completed treatment audit would be needed to remove the audit-needed caveat entirely.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Expose the proposed-only/audit-needed caveat in the visible treatment prose, not only in frontmatter scope notes.
